entries.title: Balanced Industrial Expansion · 0.4.2A
entries.detail: Twelve additional materials and factories extend the retained six-material expansion. Four new research IDs plus the existing Advanced Metallurgy license form the new chains. Minigame Studio is requirements only; no deployment is announced.

entries.title: Industrial Expansion · Phase 1
entries.detail: Six connected materials, eight factories, three research licenses and three cosmetic goals for Singleplayer. Staging multiplayer work remains separate; no deployment is announced.

entries.title: Modern Frontier
entries.detail: A new world hub, construction catalog, appearance studio, world backups and Singleplayer advancements. Multiplayer economy awaits backend security validation.

entries.title: Visual restoration
entries.detail: Visible normal-zoom forests, clearer terrain, cached rendering and a navy/cyan interface. Not a deployed release announcement.

entries.title: Industrial Revolution · A/B/C1
entries.detail: Exact uncapped offline production, 120 industrial definitions, 100 player-facing materials and seven introductory research technologies.
